name: GUI-Knowledge-Bench
description: A benchmark for evaluating models' knowledge and reasoning about graphical user interfaces (GUIs), including understanding GUI elements, actions, and layouts. It measures the ability to answer GUI-focused questions and perform tasks such as identifying components or predicting user actions given an interface description. Designed to test practical interface-related knowledge and instruction following.
reputation: A niche benchmark with limited but growing use among researchers working on UI understanding and instruction-following tasks.
